records.subject: spec-guard-codex-desktop-ticket
evidence: host:the active native Codex Desktop task loaded the installed v0.19.0 ticket skill
result:spec_guard_local_ledger epiq_issue_list with brief=true and includeClosed=false returned the same existing open ticket as the new Claude Code CLI session
result:no ticket or repository write was requested; creation, editing, closing, and cross-project messaging were not tested

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli
evidence: host:a new ephemeral Codex CLI session loaded the installed v0.19.0 ticket skill from the plugin cache
result:the session ran under a read-only sandbox with no repository or ticket writes

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli-ticket
evidence: host:the new Codex CLI session used the installed ticket skill and called spec_guard_local_ledger epiq_issue_list with brief=true and includeClosed=false
result:the query returned the same existing open ticket observed in Codex Desktop and Claude Code CLI
result:creation, editing, closing, and cross-project messaging were not tested

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-desktop-ticket-write
evidence: scope:an isolated temporary Git repository without origin was initialized through the connected Epiq MCP; the existing project ledger was not modified
host:the native Codex Desktop task called epiq_issue_create, epiq_issue_comment_add, epiq_issue_get, and epiq_issue_close
result:a temporary test ticket was created, its comment was read back, and a final read returned isClosed=true
result:no collaboration message was sent; Epiq attempted to push to absent origin and reported the expected warnings, with no remote write
